note: Clinton County Conservation park where the Wapsipinicon meets the Mississippi backwaters, southwest of Camanche off Hwy 67 (turn at Wendling Quarry). The West area's sites sit by the playground and shower house; on the East peninsula a row of back-ins faces Schricker Slough across open grass. Marina slips, boat ramp, boat rentals, the Mississippi River Eco Tourism Center and Blue Heron eco-cruises. Trailers must back in. --Claude
summary: Rates confirmed ($25 first-come / $30 reserved electric; high now 30). Added water/sewer false (electric-only sites, fill hydrants), potable water, camp store, booking link, 14-night limit, check-in; confirmed showers, dump, year-round. The stored weekend/holiday minimum in fees.note was not found on any county or booking page and is dropped. Riverfront confirmed: the East back-in row ends ~25-35 m from the ~57-m slough across open mown grass, no road between.
flags: WATERFRONT (riverfront kept): NAIP at 41.7491,-90.3245 shows the East peninsula's back-in row on the east bank of Schricker Slough (a Mississippi backwater channel ~55-60 m wide here) with ~25-35 m of open mown grass and a few trees between the pad ends and the bank, and the camp road behind the pads (east), not between. Sites in this row are roughly the 33-54 run on the county's 5/21/2025 East map. The stored waterfront_evidence was only a commit reference; this read supplies it.
PIN: 41.75079,-90.32676 is on the Eco Tourism Center at the marina, between the West area (~300 m NW) and the East row (~200 m SE); within tolerance for a two-area campground, no change proposed.
